responsibility: Implements HP PA-RISC common option handling for architecture-level machine selection. It sets the combined default target/CPU flag baseline and maps option spellings such as -msnake, -mpa-risc-1-0/1-1/2-0, and corresponding -march variants onto the internal PA_11 and PA_20 target flag bits, ensuring later HPPA backend code works from a consistent representation of the selected processor generation.
